title: oenothera parviflora var. muricata
intro: Oenothera parviflora var. muricata, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Onagraceae family. It is native to the mountainous regions of North America and has been traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes, eczema, and other skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Evening Primrose are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including gamma-linolenic acid (GLA) and other polyunsaturated fatty acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anticoagulant properties.
